name: CHIP_EXTENSIONS
description:
Flag that determines if image extensions are to be treated as independent
 science data to be fitted for independently or as CHIP specific subranges 
 of a single observation to be fitted for as a single combined spectrum.
 Value = TRUE implies to treat as CHIPS to be combined. Value = FALSE implies
 to treat as independent. [FALSE]

name: CLEAN_MODEL_FLUX
description: Set model flux to 0 for non-fitted pixels

name: COLUMN_DFLUX
description: Flux error column (Avoided by writing 'NULL') : 1-sigma error on the flux

name: COLUMN_FLUX
description: Flux column

name: COLUMN_LAMBDA
description:
Wavelength column ('NULL' can be used if the file is an image and that
 the data are in the primary
 (data are given by the FITS header keywords [CRVAL1=wave_ini, CD1_1=step])
 If CD1_1 is absent, then the DEPRECATED CDELT1 keyword will be used.

name: COLUMN_MASK
description: Mask column (Avoided by writing 'NULL') : Indicates if a pixel is invalid

name: CONTINUUM_CONST
description:
Initial constant term for continuum fit (valid for all fit ranges)
 [emission spectrum: about 1 for correct flux_unit]

name: CONTINUUM_N
description:
Polynomial order for continuum model for each region. Presented as a comma deliminated string.
 If set to NULL, check if the TAG[WAVE_INCLUDE] points to a FITS BINTABLE with column CONT_POLY_ORDER provided

name: DEFAULT_ERROR
description:
Default error relative to mean for the case that the error column
 is not provided

name: ELEVATION_KEYWORD
description: Elevation above sea level in m (default is Paranal: 2635. m)

name: ELEVATION_VALUE
description: If ELEVATION_KEYWORD=='NONE' take this value

name: EMIX
description:
Upper mixing height in km for considering data of a local meteo station.
 If emix is below geoelev, rhum, pres, and temp are not used
 for modifying the corresponding profiles.

name: EXPERT_MODE
description: If set to true, will check if TAG[INIT_FIT_PARAMETERS] points to a fits file with a bintable of parameter values to use as initial values for the fitting process

name: FIT_CONTINUUM
description:
Comma deliminated string of flags (1=true, 0=false) for fitting continuum in specific regions.
 If set to NULL, check if the TAG[WAVE_INCLUDE] points to a FITS BINTABLE with column CONT_FIT_FLAG provided

name: FIT_MOLEC
description:
List of flags that specify which of the listed molecules are to be fitted for.
 Flag=1 implies yes. Flag=0 implies no. Represented as a string of comma separated
 integers in the same order as the listed molecules. For example: if LIST_MOLEC="H2O,CO2,O3", then 
 FIT_MOLEC="1,0,1" implies that only H2O and O3 should be fitted for.
 If set to NULL, the input TAG[MOLECULES] FITS BINTABLE values have to be provided where the FITS 
 BINTABLE specified contains the three columns: LIST_MOLEC; FIT_MOLEC; and REL_COL.

name: FIT_RES_BOX
description: Fit the width of a Boxcar LSF

name: FIT_RES_GAUSS
description: Fit the FWHM of a Gaussian LSF

name: FIT_RES_LORENTZ
description: Fit the FWHM of a Lorentzian LSF

name: FIT_TELESCOPE_BACKGROUND
description: Fit of telescope background -- 1 = yes; 0 = no (emission spectrum only)

name: FIT_WLC
description:
Flags for including regions in wavelength corrections.
 If set to NULL, check if the TAG[WAVE_INCLUDE] points to
 a FITS BINTABLE with column WLC_FIT_FLAG provided.

name: FLUX_UNIT
description:
Conversion of fluxes from phot/(s*m2*mum*as2) (emission spectrum only)
    to flux unit of observed spectrum:
 0: phot / (s *  m^2 * mum * as^2) [no conversion]
 1:    W / (     m^2 * mum * as^2)
 2:  erg / (s * cm^2 *   A * as^2)
 3:  mJy / (                 as^2)
 For other units, the conversion factor has to be considered
  as constant term of the continuum fit.

name: FTOL
description: Relative chi-square convergence criterion

name: GDAS_PROFILE
description:
Specify which GDAS profile to use. Possible values: 
 - 'auto',  automatic retrieval of the GDAS profiles
 (P[hPa] HGT[km] T[K] RELHUM[%]) close in time to the
 observation and in location to the observatory. If 
 the files are not on disk and there is no internet 
 connection, the average profile is taken from      
 share/molecfit/data/profiles/lib corresponding to  
 the month of the observation (GDAS_t0_s1.fits for  
 Dec/Jan, GDAS_t0_s2.fits for Feb/Mar, etc)         
 See Sec. 8.1.4 of the molecfit manual for more info.
 - 'null', use the profile in the SOF with tag GDAS. 
 If there is no profile in the SOF, the behaviour    
 is the same as GDAS_PROF=auto.                      
 - 'none', use the average profile taken from       
 share/molecfit/data/profiles/lib corresponding to  
 the month of observation (see 'auto' description). 
 - 'directory/file.fits', use the specified path and
 filename as the GDAS profile. Either an absolute path
 (starting with '/') or a relative path may be used,
 however a relative path is preferred, since only  
 the first 40 char of the path and filename are    
 copied to the FITS header. The file format must be
 a FITS binary table with columns having the names: 
 'press height temp relhum' and units:              
 hPa, km, K and %, respectively.

name: KERNFAC
description: Size of Voigtian/Gaussian/Lorentzian kernel in FWHM

name: KERNMODE
description: Voigtian profile approximation instead of independent Gaussian and Lorentzian?

name: LATITUDE_KEYWORD
description: Latitude (default is Paranal: -24.6276 deg)

name: LATITUDE_VALUE
description: If LATITUDE_KEYWORD=='NONE' take this value

name: LAYERS
description:
Grid of layer heights for merging ref_atm and GDAS profile.
 Fixed grid = CPL_TRUE and natural grid = CPL_FALSE

name: LBLRTM_ALFAL0

name: LBLRTM_ALTD1

name: LBLRTM_ALTD2

name: LBLRTM_AVMASS

name: LBLRTM_AVTRAT

name: LBLRTM_BETA
description: Earth centered angle from H1 to H2 [degrees]

name: LBLRTM_DELV

name: LBLRTM_DPTFAC
description: Factor multiplying molecular continuum optical depth

name: LBLRTM_DPTMIN
description: Minimum molecular optical depth below which lines will be rejected

name: LBLRTM_H2
description: Upper height limit [km]

name: LBLRTM_HOBS
description: Height of observer

name: LBLRTM_HSPACE

name: LBLRTM_IAERSL

name: LBLRTM_ICNTNM

name: LBLRTM_IPUNCH

name: LBLRTM_ITYPE

name: LBLRTM_LEN

name: LBLRTM_MODEL
description: Atmospheric profile [0,1,2,3,4,5,6]

name: LBLRTM_MPTS
description: Number of optical depth values

name: LBLRTM_NOPRNT
description: Do not print output? [0,1]

name: LBLRTM_NOZERO
description: Zeroing of small amounts of absorbers [0,1]

name: LBLRTM_NPTS

name: LBLRTM_RANGE
description: Length of a straight path from H1 to H2 [km]

name: LBLRTM_RE
description: Radius of earth [km]

name: LBLRTM_SAMPLE
description: Number of sample points per mean halfwidth [between 1 to 4, default=4]

name: LBLRTM_SREMIS1
description: Emissivity coefficient 1

name: LBLRTM_SREMIS2
description: Emissivity coefficient 2

name: LBLRTM_SREMIS3
description: Emissivity coefficient 3

name: LBLRTM_SRREFL1
description: Reflectivity coefficient 1

name: LBLRTM_SRREFL2
description: Reflectivity coefficient 2

name: LBLRTM_SRREFL3
description: Reflectivity coefficient 3

name: LBLRTM_TBOUND
description: Temperature of boundary [K]

name: LBLRTM_TDIFF1
description: Maximum layer temperature difference at ALTD1 [K]

name: LBLRTM_TDIFF2
description: Maximum layer temperature difference at ALTD2 [K]

name: LBLRTM_V1
description: Beginning wavenumber value for the calculation

name: LBLRTM_V2
description: Ending wavenumber value for the calculation

name: LIST_MOLEC
description:
List of molecules to be included in the model. Represented as a comma separated
 string of molecule names, e.g. "H2O,CO2,O3".
 If set to NULL, the input TAG[MOLECULES] FITS BINTABLE values have to be provided
 where the FITS BINTABLE specified contains the three columns:
 LIST_MOLEC; FIT_MOLEC; and REL_COL.

name: LNFL_LINE_DB
description:
File name of the line list (must be stored in the directory :
 ({TELLURICCORR_DATA_PATH}/hitran/)

name: LNFL_LINE_DB_FORMAT
description: Format of the line file: gives the length in terms of characters per line

name: LONGITUDE_KEYWORD
description: Longitude (default is Paranal: -70.4051 deg)

name: LONGITUDE_VALUE
description: If LONGITUDE_KEYWORD=='NONE' take this value

name: MAP_REGIONS_TO_CHIP
description:
Comma deliminated string of chip indices that each range is associated with.
 If set to NULL, check if the TAG[WAVE_INCLUDE] points to a FITS BINTABLE with column MAPPED_TO_CHIP provided

name: MIRROR_TEMPERATURE_KEYWORD
description: Mirror temperature in deg C

name: MIRROR_TEMPERATURE_VALUE
description: If MIRROR_TEMPERATURE_KEYWORD=='NONE' take this value

name: MODEL_MAPPING_KERNEL
description:
Mapping 'STD_MODEL/SCIENCE' - 'MODEL_KERNEL_LIBRARY' [string with ext_number comma separated (int)] :
 If set to NULL, check if the TAG[MODEL_MAPPING_KERNEL] FITS BINTABLE values is provided.
 The FITS BINTABLE have to one column [KERNEL_LIBRARY_EXT]

name: OBSERVING_DATE_KEYWORD
description: Observing date in years or MJD in days (not string)

name: OBSERVING_DATE_VALUE
description: If OBSERVING_DATE_KEYWORD=='NONE' take this value

name: OBS_ERF_RV_KEY
description:
The radial velocity of the observatory in km/s
 relative to the external reference frame;
 It is positive if the distance between the science target and the Earth
 increases along the line-of-sight to the science target.
 It must be provided if MF_PARAMETERS_WAVELENGTH_FRAME = 'VAC_RV'

name: OBS_ERF_RV_VALUE
description: If OBS_ERF_RV_KEYWORD=='NONE' take this value

name: PIXEL_EXCLUDE
description:
Pixel ranges to be excluded. Represented as a string of comma separated integers in pairs specifying the
 start and end pixel of a range. For example: PIXEL_EXCLUDE="54,128,512,514,1020,1024" represents three
 exclusion regions: [54,128], [512,514] and [1020,1024].
 If set to NULL, molecfit will check if the TAG[PIXEL_EXCLUDE] FITS BINTABLE values is provided where the
 FITS BINTABLE specified has the two columns: LOWER_LIMIT; and UPPER_LIMIT.

name: PIX_SCALE_KEYWORD
description: Pixel scale in arcsec (taken from this file only)

name: PIX_SCALE_VALUE
description: If PIX_SCALE_KEYWORD=='NONE' take this value

name: PRESSURE_KEYWORD
description: Pressure in hPa

name: PRESSURE_VALUE
description: If PRESSURE_KEYWORD=='NONE' take this value

name: PWV
description:
PWV value in mm for the input water vapor profile.
 The merged profile composed of ref_atm, GDAS, and local meteo data
 will be scaled to this value if pwv > 0 (default: -1 -> no scaling)

name: REFERENCE_ATMOSPHERIC
RELATIVE_HUMIDITY_KEYWORD
description: Relative humidity in %

name: RELATIVE_HUMIDITY_VALUE
description: If RELATIVE_HUMIDITY_KEYWORD=='NONE' take this value

name: REL_COL
description:
List of the intial values of fitting of the molecular columns expressed relatively to the input
  ATM profile columns. Represented as a comma separated list of doubles in the same order as the 
 listed molecules. For example, if LIST_MOLEC="H2O,CO2,O3", then REL_COL="1.0,1.2,0.8"
 implies that H2O, CO2 and O3 have initial relative values of 1.0, 1.2 and 0.8 respectively.
 If set to NULL, the input TAG[MOLECULES] FITS BINTABLE values have to be provided where the FITS 
 BINTABLE specified contains the three columns: LIST_MOLEC; FIT_MOLEC; and REL_COL.

name: RES_BOX
description:
Initial value for FWHM of Boxcar rel. to slit width
 at the centre of the spectrum

name: RES_GAUSS
description:
Initial value for FWHM of the Gaussian in pixels
 at the centre of the spectrum

name: RES_LORENTZ
description:
Initial value for FWHM of the Lorentz in pixels
 at the centre of the spectrum

name: SILENT_EXTERNAL_BINS
description: Silent the output of the external binaries

name: SLIT_WIDTH_KEYWORD
description: Slit width in arcsec (taken from FITS header if present)

name: SLIT_WIDTH_VALUE
description: If SLIT_WIDTH_KEYWORD=='NONE' take this value

name: TELESCOPE_ANGLE_KEYWORD
description: Telescope altitude angle in deg

name: TELESCOPE_ANGLE_VALUE
description: If TELESCOPE_ANGLE_KEYWORD=='NONE' take this value

name: TELESCOPE_BACKGROUND_CONST
description: Initial value for telescope background fit

name: TELLURICCORR_DATA_PATH
description: Data directory

name: TELLURICCORR_PATH
description: Installation directory

name: TEMPERATURE_KEYWORD
description: Ambient temperature in deg C

name: TEMPERATURE_VALUE
description: If TEMPERATURE_KEYWORD=='NONE' take this value

name: TMP_PATH
description: Temporary directory

name: TRANSMISSION
description: Type of input spectrum : 0 = Emission(radiance); 1 = Transmission

name: USE_DATA_EXTENSION_AS_DFLUX
description:
Only valid if USE_ONLY_INPUT_PRIMARY_DATA=TRUE. The fits extension index that contains the
 errors of the science flux data (DFLUX). A value of 0 implies that there is no DFLUX

name: USE_DATA_EXTENSION_AS_MASK
description:
Only valid if USE_ONLY_INPUT_PRIMARY_DATA=TRUE. The fits extension index that contains the
 mask associated with the science flux data. A value of 0 implies that there is no mask data.

name: USE_INPUT_KERNEL
description: If TRUE, use the kernel library if it is provided.

name: USE_ONLY_INPUT_PRIMARY_DATA
description:
Value=TRUE implies that only the fits primary contains the input science flux data.
 Value=FALSE implies that the fits extensions also contains input science flux data.

name: UTC_KEYWORD
description: UTC in s

name: UTC_VALUE
description: If UTC_KEYWORD=='NONE' take this value

name: VARKERN
description: Does the kernel size increase linearly with wavelength?

name: WAVELENGTH_FRAME
description:
Wavelength in vacuum                                      = 'VAC'.
 Wavelength in air    with the observatory reference frame = 'AIR'.
 Wavelength in air    with another         reference frame = 'AIR_RV'.
 Wavelength in vacuum with another         reference frame = 'VAC_RV'.
   (typically the  sun or the barycenter of the solar system).
 In the latter case, the radial velocity of the observatory relative
   to the external reference frame must be provided in the parameter obs_RV

name: WAVE_EXCLUDE
description:
Wavelength ranges to be excluded. Represented as a string of comma separated doubles in pairs 
 specifying the start and end wavelengths of a range. The wavelength units are always in microns.
 as the input science data. For example a KMOS sample data in the range of 1.11um to 1.67um may have
 WAVE_EXCLUDE="1.773,1.78633,1.79098,1.80434,1.187691,1.189937" to represent three exclusion regions:
 [1.773,1.78633], [1.79098,1.80434] and [1.187691,1.189937].
 If set to NULL, molecfit will check if the TAG[WAVE_EXCLUDE] FITS BINTABLE values is provided where
 the FITS BINTABLE specified has the two columns: LOWER_LIMIT; and UPPER_LIMIT.

name: WAVE_INCLUDE
description:
Wavelength ranges to be included. Represented as a string of comma separated doubles in pairs 
 specifying the start and end wavelengths of a range. The wavelength units are always in microns.
 For example a KMOS sample data in the range of 1.11um to 1.67um may have
 WAVE_INCLUDE="1.773,1.78633,1.79098,1.80434,1.187691,1.189937" to represent three inclusion regions:
 [1.773,1.78633], [1.79098,1.80434] and [1.187691,1.189937].
 If set to NULL, molecfit will check if the TAG[WAVE_INCLUDE] FITS BINTABLE values is provided where
 the FITS BINTABLE specified has the two columns: LOWER_LIMIT; and UPPER_LIMIT.

name: WLC_CONST
description:
Initial constant term for wavelength adjustment
 (shift relative to half wavelength range)

name: WLC_N
description: Polynomial degree of the refined wavelength solution

name: WLG_TO_MICRON
description:
Multiplicative factor applied to the wavelength to express is in micron.
 E.g.: if wavelength is given in nm, the value should be 0.001.

name: XTOL
description: Relative parameter convergence criterion
